messages:
Clara (Design): quick design check: i explored a compact legend variant that hides long unit words and shows an overflow glyph if values are clipped. thoughts?
Omar (Eng-Frontend): compact looks tidy but we need clear affordances. overflow glyph must be keyboard focusable and open the expanded axis.
Tess (DataViz): on clipping: rather than hard clip, can we do a soft-clip at 99.2 percentile and show a small chevron overlay on affected points + a hashed band on axis? gives context without blowing the scale.
June (PM): product preference: default should avoid surprising rescaling. soft-clip default, with "Show full range" action per chart. also surface how many points were clipped in legend like "(3)".
Clara (Design): sketch for legend item: [swatch] Name — unit_abbrev — [smoothed chip] [vis toggle] [clipped count]. clipped count acts as button to expand axis.
Omar (Eng-Frontend): backend note: will add series_meta {clipped_count, clamp_val, sampled_pct} to the series endpoint; flag percentile compute behind sampling to keep perf ok.
Tess (DataViz): smoothing: add per-series smoothing chip in legend. visual cue: smoothed line uses slightly softer color + dashed alt stroke. preview on hover without committing.
A11yBot: reminder: any interactive in legend must have accessible name and state. announce actions with aria-live polite: e.g., "Series X hidden" or "Axis expanded". track ticket #754.
Clara (Design): microcopy for overflow tooltip: "Value exceeds display range; values above shown as clipped. Click to reveal full axis." glyph aria-label: "Expand axis, n clipped".
June (PM): rollout plan: 1) add clipped meta + glyph, 2) per-series smoothing chip + hover preview, 3) a11y sweep. ship behind feature flag and run small AB to compare trend perception.
Omar (Eng-Frontend): i'll wire feature flag, storybook states, and focus styles. will make glyph tabbable and add aria-expanded toggles.
Tess (DataViz): i'll run quick prototypes to measure effect on users detecting anomalies vs comparing magnitude. will post results in thread.
Clara (Design): thanks — i'll update mocks and include keyboard flows. dropping PNGs here later. :seedling:
